title: CancelShipment payload (compensation command, topic fulfillment.commands)
description: Cancel the order's shipment. Idempotent: cancelling twice, or cancelling an order with no shipment, is a no-op; either way a later CreateShipment is rejected. Replies: ShipmentCancelled or ShipmentCancelFailed.

reason.description: Why the saga is compensating, for logs and audit.
